entities.name: Q54FK2 RabN2
observations: Exact sequence match to the submitted 184-residue protein; curated Swiss-Prot reference from Dictyostelium discoideum.
Annotated as a small GTP-binding protein with GTPase activity.
Annotated localization includes late endosome, lysosome, and phagocytic vesicle.
Annotated biological process includes phagosome-lysosome fusion.

entities.name: RabN2 sequence properties
observations: Protein length is 184 amino acids; calculated molecular mass is 21,341 Da; theoretical pI is 5.82.
Pfam detects Ras domain PF00071.29 at residues 1-172 and Roc domain PF08477.20 at residues 1-99.

entities.name: Rab GTP hydrolysis
observations: Candidate catalytic reaction is GTP + H2O = GDP + phosphate + H(+), Rhea RHEA:19669.

entities.name: Phagosome-lysosome fusion
observations: Q54FK2 RabN2 is annotated to phagosome-lysosome fusion, GO:0090385.
